name: Pilli Sai Surya Kiran
headline: AI/ML Engineer · NLP, RAG & Applied Deep Learning
bio: AI/ML engineer based in Bengaluru, working across NLP, deep learning, and RAG/LLM pipelines. I hold an MCA in Computing & AI from North-Eastern Hill University and a BSc in Computer Science from Andhra University. My dissertation combined GRU, BiGRU, BiLSTM, and attention mechanisms for emotion detection from text, and I've since built fraud detection pipelines, retrieval-augmented generation systems, and applied ML projects spanning research and industry settings.

experience.company: Intact Intern Stump Solutions Pvt. Ltd.
description: Worked on applied machine learning and NLP tasks, building and evaluating model pipelines using Python and PyTorch/TensorFlow.
Contributed to LLM and RAG-related workflows, including experimentation with LangChain, LlamaIndex, and ChromaDB.
Collaborated using Git/GitHub for version control and Docker for environment consistency across development and testing.

Dissertation: "Emotion Detection from Text using Hybrid Deep Learning Architectures" — a GRU + BiGRU + BiLSTM + Attention model achieving 96.76% accuracy on the 28-class GoEmotions benchmark (43,411 samples).
Supervised by Dr. Ansuman Kumar, NEHU Tura Campus.

projects.title: Emotion Detection from Text (MCA Dissertation)
projects.description: A hybrid deep learning architecture (GRU + BiGRU + BiLSTM + Attention) for multi-label emotion classification, achieving 96.76% accuracy on the 28-class GoEmotions benchmark across 43,411 samples.
